definitions.explanation: A raised structure or table used for religious rituals, offerings, or memorial services. Used across religious traditions including Shinto, Buddhism, and Christianity.

examples.japanese: {祭壇|さいだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{供|そな}える→供える：11562_sonaeru⟧。
examples.english: To place flowers on the altar.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教会|きょうかい}→教会：01387_kyoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{祭壇|さいだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{誓|ちか}い→誓い：14178_chikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てた→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
examples.english: They made their vows before the altar of the church.

examples.japanese: ⟦{故人|こじん}→故人：02807_kojin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{偲|しの}んで→偲ぶ：30130_shinobu⟧、{祭壇|さいだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{遺品|いひん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飾|かざ}られていた→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: In memory of the deceased, photographs and personal belongings were displayed on the altar.

notes:
USAGE:
Used broadly across religious contexts. In Japanese funerals, a {祭壇|さいだん} is set up with the deceased's photograph, flowers, and offerings. Also refers to altars in churches, shrines, and temples.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {祭壇|さいだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{供|そな}える→供える：11562_sonaeru⟧: to make an offering at the altar
- {祭壇|さいだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設|もう}ける→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧: to set up an altar
- {祭壇|さいだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧: to put one's hands together (pray) at the altar
- ⟦{葬儀|そうぎ}→葬儀：15337_sougi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{祭壇|さいだん}: funeral altar
